title: Agreement of two first-term selections
statement: Let $\varphi$ be a DNF formula on $n$ sign-valued Boolean variables, and let $\rho$ be a coordinate restriction for which the restricted function is nonconstant. The first compatible term index defined using that nonconstancy agrees with the first compatible term index defined using the resulting nonempty set of compatible indices.
hypotheses_covered: $\varphi$ is a DNF formula on $n$ variables
The function restricted by $\rho$ is nonconstant
